calibration_exposure.status: calibration-visible model-form extension; execution-heldout outcome firewall remains closed

conditioning_state.allowed_form: one shared wall-state law using log(carbon-cycle count) plus Si and SiO2 preconditioning indicators
conditioning_state.physical_action: bounded multiplier on effective neutral wall-loss velocity, carried through the reactor state rather than added to predicted depth

surface_laws_unchanged: La Magna/Garozzo C4F8 film and SiO2 removal

model_extension.azimuthal_coordinate: official measured x-y frame; no post-reveal rotation or reflection

cylindrical_grid.refinement_requirement: all acceptance observables change by less than 0.25 of their frozen gate between fit and certification grids

harmonic_source.form: positive exponential Fourier modulation of each effective species source
harmonic_source.selection: add complete harmonic orders sequentially and select the lowest order meeting leave-one-lot-out calibration gates; ties choose lower order

operators: measured 5 Hz machine waveform to conservative effective-species inventory
positive cylindrical r-phi-z finite-volume diffusion and Robin wall loss
bilinear r and periodic-phi interpolation at all 89 measured coordinates
exact unchanged fused Belen and La Magna surface recurrence
model_extension.reason: the calibration-only oracle audit proves any shared axisymmetric map has at least 2.128943 percent normalized shape RMSE, above the frozen 2 percent gate

selection_and_seal.calibration_margin_requirement: leave-one-lot-out aggregate scores must meet all frozen heldout gates; normalized shape RMSE must be at most 1.8 percent before sealing
selection_and_seal.harmonic_complexity_rule: lowest complete Fourier order satisfying every calibration margin
selection_and_seal.objective: sum of squared aggregate leave-one-lot-out errors normalized by the corresponding frozen gate; no wafer receives an independent fit parameter
seal_contents: all parameter bounds and selected values

forbidden_shortcuts: changing either surface mechanism or yield law during cylindrical calibration
fitting an unconstrained value at each of the 89 coordinates
rotating or reflecting the source map after heldout reveal
selecting harmonic order or parameter bounds from heldout results
reporting calibration fit as heldout validation
